NEW EPISODE! The Muppets got a roller coaster 🎢 Disney Unscripted got the backstage access 🎸🎬
In this episode of Disney Unscripted, go behind the scenes with Walt Disney Imagineering, Disney Live Entertainment, musicians, celebrity guests, and cast members as they transform one of Disney's most thrilling attractions into a wild ride headlined by Dr. Teeth and The Electric Mayhem.

From recording all-new music tracks and programming onboard audio to repainting the attraction's iconic guitar and reimagining the queue and pre-show experience, see how creative teams worked together to bring this high-energy adventure to life. You'll also get an inside look at attraction testing, final show adjustments, and the many details that had to come together before opening day.

Then, join The Electric Mayhem and special guests as they celebrate the grand opening before fans experience the attraction for the very first time. Discover how Disney Imagineers blended music, storytelling, technology, and a little bit of Muppet mayhem to create a brand-new chapter for this fan-favorite coaster.
